questions.domain: 領域 2：生成式 AI 基礎 (Fundamentals of GenAI)

question_text.zh: 一家公司使用一个开源的预训练模型来分析新发布产品的用戶情感。 根据 MLOps 最佳实践,该公司必须执行哪项操作?
question_text.en: A company uses an open source pre-trained model to analyze user sentiment for a newly released product. Which action must the company perform, according to MLOps best practices?

A.zh: 使用深度学习执行超参数调优。
A.en: Use deep learning to perform hyperparameter tuning.

B.zh: 收集用戶评论并将每条评论标记为正面或负面。
B.en: Collect user reviews and label each review as positive or negative.

C.zh: 在生产环境中持续监控输出。
C.en: Continuously monitor outputs in production.

D.zh: 对输入数据集执行特征工程。
D.en: Perform feature engineering on the input dataset.

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，超参数调优不是 “必须 ”步骤,尤其是直接使用开源预训练模型做推理时,可能根本不进行训练 /微调。 “使用深度学习执行超参调优 ”表述也不符合常⻅实践;超参调优通常是网格 /随机 /⻉叶斯优化等,不是 “用深度学习来调参 ”这一类 MLOps 必选项
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action must the company perform, according to MLOps best practices? The source-supported choice is C. Continuously monitor outputs in production..

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，(更偏错误)。 标注数据是训练 /微调 /评估的关键输入,但题干只说 “使用预训练模型进行情感分析 ”,并未要求必须再训练。 MLOps 的“必须 ”更偏向上线后的监控与运营;标注属于可能的持续改进手段,但不是在所有场景下都必须立即做。 此外,情感分析常⻅不止 “正/负”两类,可能还有 “中性 ”、多级评分等;题目把标注限定为正 /负也不够通用
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action must the company perform, according to MLOps best practices? The source-supported choice is C. Continuously monitor outputs in production..

C.zh: 正確。原因是，MLOps 核心之一是生产监控:监控预测分布变化、错误率 /置信度、异常输入、用戶反馈、漂移与性能退化。 新产品场景下,用戶表达方式、语料分布可能快速变化,更需要监控以发现模型不适配与⻛险(例如误判、偏差、对新梗 /新语境失效)。 “持续 ”体现 MLOps 的闭环:监控 → 触发再训练 /调整 → 再部署
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which action must the company perform, according to MLOps best practices?

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，(更偏错误)。 对 NLP 情感分析的预训练模型(如 Transformer 类)通常直接使用文本输入,传统 “特征工程 (如” TF-IDF、手工特征)并非必须,且可能与预训练表示学习思路不一致。 即便需要做输入清洗 /规范化(去噪、脱敏、语言检测等),也不等同于 “必须做特征工程 ”。 题目问的是 MLOps best practices 的“必须动作 ”,最稳的是上线后的持续监控,而非训练前的工程步骤
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which action must the company perform, according to MLOps best practices? The source-supported choice is C. Continuously monitor outputs in production..

answer_text.zh: C. 在生产环境中持续监控输出。
answer_text.en: C. Continuously monitor outputs in production.

discussion.zh: 來源社群投票分布為 C 100%。討論重點是比較各選項是否真正滿足題目主要需求；最終答案依來源解析與技術判斷採用 C。
discussion.en: The source community vote distribution is C 100%. The discussion focuses on whether each option satisfies the primary requirement; the final answer follows the source analysis and technical reasoning: C.

question_text.zh: 一家公司使用 Amazon Bedrock 基础模型( FM)来为内部用例总结文档。该公司在 Amazon Bedrock 中训练了一个自定义模型,以提高模型摘要的质量。公司需要一种解决方案,以便在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用该自定义模型。 哪种解决方案将满足此要求?
question_text.en: A company uses an Amazon Bedrock foundation model (FM) to summarize documents for an internal use case. The company trained a custom model in Amazon Bedrock to improve the quality of the model's summarizations. The company needs a solution to use the customized model on Amazon Bedrock. Which solution will meet this requirement?

A.zh: 为该自定义模型购买预置吞吐量( Provisioned Throughput)。
A.en: Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model.

B.zh: 在 Amazon SageMaker AI 端点中部署该自定义模型以进行实时推理。
B.en: Deploy the custom model in an Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint for real-time inference.

C.zh: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 模型注册表( Model Registry)注册该模型。
C.en: Register the model with the Amazon SageMaker Model Registry.

D.zh: 将该模型版本的审批状态更新为已批准( Approved)。
D.en: Update the approval status of the model version to Approved.

A.zh: 正確。原因是，原因: Bedrock 中的自定义模型( Customized model)通常需要通过 Provisioned Throughput 来启用推理容量与稳定服务(专用吞吐 /并发能力)。购买预置吞吐量后,才能以可预测的性能在 Bedrock Runtime 中调用该自定义模型
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which solution will meet this requirement?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因:题目要求 “在 Amazon Bedrock 上使用该自定义模型 ”。Bedrock 的自定义模型并不是让你把模型直接 “拿出来 ”部署到 SageMaker Endpoint;而且该选项改变了平台(从 Bedrock 变成 SageMaker),不满足 “use the customized model on Amazon Bedrock”的要求
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model..

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因: SageMaker Model Registry 用于 SageMaker 体系下的模型版本管理、审批与部署流程治理;它不会让 Bedrock 的自定义模型 “可在 Bedrock 上调用 ”。与题干 “在 Bedrock 使用自定义模型 ”的直接需求不匹配
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model..

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因:这是典型的 SageMaker Model Registry 的治理动作(将模型版本置为 Approved 以进入部署阶段)。但题干没有涉及 SageMaker Registry 流程;且即使 Approved,也不等同于 Bedrock 自定义模型在 Bedrock Runtime 可被调用,更不能替代 Bedrock 所需的吞吐量配置
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will meet this requirement? The source-supported choice is A. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model..

answer_text.zh: A. 为该自定义模型购买预置吞吐量( Provisioned Throughput)。
answer_text.en: A. Purchase Provisioned Throughput for the custom model.

A.en: Amazon Bedrock

B.en: Amazon Comprehend

C.en: Amazon Q

B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AWS service meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is A. Amazon Bedrock.

question_text.en: HOTSPOT - A company wants to customize a foundation model (FM). The company wants to understand the customization methods and data types that are available. Select the correct customization method from the following list for each description. Select each customization method one time.

A.en: Use labeled data to improve specific-task performance: Fine-tuning.
A.zh: 使用带标签数据提升特定任务表现：微调。

B.en: Use unlabeled data to adapt an FM to a domain: Continued pre-training.
B.zh: 使用无标签数据使 FM 适应特定领域：持续预训练。

question_text.zh: 哪种类型的机器学习技术提供了 **最高的可解释性 **?
question_text.en: Which type of ML technique provides the MOST explainability?

A.zh: 线性回归
A.en: Linear regression

B.zh: 支持向量机
B.en: Support vector machines

C.zh: 随机切割森林( RCF
C.en: Random cut forest (RCF)

D.zh: 神经网络
D.en: Neural network

A.zh: 正確。原因是，理由: 模型形式为 y = w·x + b,每个特征的系数 w可直接解释为对输出的线性影响(方向与相对大小)。 具有很强的全局可解释性:可以清楚说明 “哪些特征推动预测上升 /下降 ”。 在AI Practitioner常⻅考点里,线性 /逻辑回归通常属于最可解释模型
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which type of ML technique provides the MOST explainability?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，理由: 若使用核函数( RBF、多项式等),决策边界在高维特征空间中形成,难以向业务人员解释。 即使是线性 SVM,其 “可解释性 ”通常也不如线性回归直观(线性 SVM解释的是分类超平面权重,仍可解释但一般不被认为 “最”)
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of ML technique provides the MOST explainability? The source-supported choice is A. Linear regression.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，理由: RCF是基于随机切割树集合的异常检测方法,输出多为异常分数与切割路径相关度。 虽然可提供一定的 “为何异常 ”的线索(例如哪些维度贡献较大),但总体属于集成 /树集合思路,通常不如线性回归全局可解释。 对“模型机制 ”本身的解释更复杂,不是最可解释类型
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of ML technique provides the MOST explainability? The source-supported choice is A. Linear regression.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，理由: 神经网络通常是典型的黑盒模型,参数层级多、非线性强。 可以借助 SHAP、LIME、可视化等做事后解释,但这属于额外解释工具,不代表模型本身具备 “最强可解释性 ”
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which type of ML technique provides the MOST explainability? The source-supported choice is A. Linear regression.

answer_text.zh: A. 线性回归

question_text.en: A company is building a custom AI solution in Amazon SageMaker Studio to analyze financial transactions for fraudulent activity in real time. The company needs to ensure that the connectivity from SageMaker Studio to Amazon Bedrock traverses the company’s VPC. Which solution meets these requirements?

A.zh: 为 SageMaker Studio 配置 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) ⻆色和策略,以访问 Amazon Bedrock。
A.en: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and policies for SageMaker Studio to access Amazon Bedrock.

B.zh: 配置 Amazon Macie,将来自 SageMaker Studio 的请求代理到 Amazon Bedrock。
B.en: Configure Amazon Macie to proxy requests from SageMaker Studio to Amazon Bedrock.

C.zh: 在 SageMaker Studio 所连接的 VPC 中,为 Amazon Bedrock API 端点配置 AWS PrivateLink 端点。
C.en: Configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints for the Amazon Bedrock API endpoints in the VPC that SageMaker Studio is connected to.

D.zh: 为 Amazon Bedrock 的使用配置一个新的 VPC。将这些 VPC 注册为对等连接。
D.en: Configure a new VPC for the Amazon Bedrock usage. Register the VPCs as peers.

A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints for the Amazon Bedrock API endpoints in the VPC that SageMaker Studio is connected to..

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误 Macie 是数据安全与敏感数据发现服务,不是网络代理 /转发组件,也不用于在 SageMaker 与 Bedrock 之间转发 API 请求。该选项与需求无关
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints for the Amazon Bedrock API endpoints in the VPC that SageMaker Studio is connected to..

C.zh: 正確。原因是，正确在 Studio 所使用的 VPC 内创建 Interface VPC Endpoint(PrivateLink) 指向 Bedrock 的 API 端点,可让 Studio 发起对 Bedrock 的调用通过 VPC 内的私网端点完成,满足 “连接穿越公司 VPC/保持在 AWS 私网 ”的要求。这是 AWS 推荐的私网访问托管服务方式

D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Configure AWS PrivateLink endpoints for the Amazon Bedrock API endpoints in the VPC that SageMaker Studio is connected to..

answer_text.zh: C. 在 SageMaker Studio 所连接的 VPC 中,为 Amazon Bedrock API 端点配置 AWS PrivateLink 端点。

A.en: Computer vision model

B.zh: 多模态 LLM
B.en: Multimodal LLM

C.zh: 扩散模型
C.en: Diffusion model

D.zh: 文本转语音模型
D.en: Text-to-speech model

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，不满足(单独使用不足) 原因: 计算机视觉模型主要解决图像分类、目标检测、 OCR、图像理解等。 即使能从图片中识别出题目文字 /结构,也通常不擅⻓ 生成 “书面答案 +解释 ”这类⻓文本推理输出。 要满足完整需求通常需要 “视觉模型 + LLM”组合;但题目问的是哪种模型类型能满足需求,单纯视觉模型不够
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which model type meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Multimodal LLM.

B.zh: 正確。原因是，满足(最佳) 原因: 可接收文本或图像输入(图像可包含题目照片、手写 /印刷内容、图表等)。 能输出文本答案,并生成解释 /解题步骤 (符合 “written answer and an explanation”)。 端到端能力更符合 “私教应用 ”场景:理解题目 + 推理 + 讲解
B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which model type meets these requirements?

C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which model type meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Multimodal LLM.

A.en: Reinforcement learning (RL)

B.en: Natural language processing (NLP)

C.en: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)

D.en: Transfer learning

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，RL主要用于通过奖励信号学习策略,常⻅于机器人、游戏、推荐、以及 LLM对 ⻬中的 RLHF等。 虽然 RL可用于优化模型输出偏好,但题干强调的是 “与外部知识库结合 ”来提升准确性,这不是 RL的定义性特征
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AI technique combines large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge bases to improve response accuracy? The source-supported choice is C. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，NLP是处理人类语言的广义领域(包含分类、翻译、问答、信息抽取等)。 题干问的是一种具体技术,且明确提到 “LLM结合外部知识库 ”,NLP过于宽泛,不对应特定 “检索 +生成 ”模式
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AI technique combines large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge bases to improve response accuracy? The source-supported choice is C. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).

C.zh: 正確。原因是，RAG的标准流程:对用戶问题进行检索(如向量检索 /关键词检索) →从外部知识库取回相关文档片段 →将片段作为上下文提供给 LLM生成答案。 该机制直接针对 “提高回答准确性 ”与“利用外部知识”
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which AI technique combines large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge bases to improve response accuracy?

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，迁移学习是训练方法:将预训练模型的知识迁移到新任务(如微调 fine-tuning)。 它不必然涉及运行时结合外部知识库;而题干强调的是结合外部知识库以提升回答准确性,这是 RAG的典型定义
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which AI technique combines large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge bases to improve response accuracy? The source-supported choice is C. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG).
